Up-to-Date article: Antimicrobial prophylaxis for prevention of surgical site

*Local guidance (St. Cloud CDSS, Inpatient):*
ENTAMOEBA HISTOLYTICA
Primary treatment for gastroenteritis
Hydration and electrolyte replacement
Antimicrobial treatment for gastroenteritis or extraintestinal disease Consult Infectious Diseases in all cases. Paromomycin is nonformulary and must be ordered by Infectious Diseases.
Metronidazole 750 mg PO q8h for 10 days ($) [DI] <FOLLOWED BY> paromomycin 25-35 mg/kg/day PO q8h for 7 days ($) [M]

Sanford keyword: Amoebiasis, Entamoeba histolytica
